import re

PAIR = re.compile(r'(?P<key>[%A-Za-z][%\w ]*?)\s*(?:\.\s?)*\s*:\s+(?P<value>[\d.:,+]+(?: [KMGTB]\b)?)')
ROW = re.compile(r'^\s*(?P<a>\d+)\s+(?P<b>\S+)\s+(?P<c>\S+)\s+(?P<d>\S+)\s+(?P<e>\S+)\s+(?P<f>\S+)\s+(?P<g>\S+)\s+(?P<h>\S+)\s+(?P<i>\S+)\s+(?P<j>\S+)\s+(?P<k>\S+)\s*$')
COLS = ['System Pool', 'Pool Size (M)', 'Reserved Size (M)', 'Max Active', 'DB Fault', 'DB Pages', 'Non-DB Fault', 'Non-DB Pages', 'Act-Wait', 'Wait-Inel', 'Act-Inel']
DECOR = re.compile(r'^\s*(Type changes|Bottom\s*$|More\.*\s*$|Command\s*$|===>|F\d+=|System\s+Pool|Pool\s+Size|Auxiliary storage:\s*$)')
TITLE = re.compile(r'Work with System Status\s+(?P<sys>\S+)')
DATE = re.compile(r'^\s*(?P<d>\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{2,4})\s+(?P<t>\d{1,2}:\d{2}:\d{2})(?:\s+(?P<z>\S+))?\s*$')

def parse(lines):
    kv = {}
    kvl = []
    rows = []
    rowl = []
    skip = []
    for n, line in enumerate(lines):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        m = TITLE.search(line)
        if m:
            kv['System'] = m.group('sys')
            kvl.append(n)
            continue
        m = DATE.match(line)
        if m:
            kv['Date'] = m.group('d')
            kv['Time'] = (m.group('t') + (' ' + m.group('z') if m.group('z') else ''))
            kvl.append(n)
            continue
        m = ROW.match(line)
        if m:
            vals = [m.group(x) for x in 'abcdefghijk']
            rows.append(dict(zip(COLS, vals)))
            rowl.append(n)
            continue
        found = False
        if ':' in line and not DECOR.search(line):
            for p in PAIR.finditer(line):
                kv[p.group('key').strip()] = p.group('value')
                found = True
        if found:
            kvl.append(n)
            continue
        if DECOR.search(line) or 'storage:' in line:
            skip.append(n)
    blocks = []
    if kv:
        blocks.append({'name': 'system status', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': kvl, 'records': [kv]})
    if rows:
        blocks.append({'name': 'pools', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': rowl, 'records': rows})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
